correctness.rationale: The fixed geometric simplices correspond exactly to compatible full orbits of triples. Exhaustive orbit enumeration at all fifteen conjugacy classes, memoized integer independence-polynomial deletion-link recursion, and reduced Lefschetz give a certified virtual rational character. Its Young-character decomposition has positive irreducible dimensions 1+14+14=29 and negative dimensions 6+1=7. Feng 2026 Theorem 18 proves those are the only two nonzero rational Betti dimensions. The positive/negative parts therefore saturate both dimensions, excluding any common irreducible cancellations and forcing the actual sixth-homology module. The checker reconstructs all irreducibles by exact integer inner products and replays successfully. Integral torsion and homotopy are not asserted.

originality.rationale: The new object is the complete rational S7-module in degree six, not the known Betti number 29 nor the separately published exterior-power degree-nine module. The primary published Kneser theorem reports degree-six rank without its character; all fifteen character values and the two nontrivial degree-six Specht constituents are additional. Checked mathematical record results on KG(6,2) neighborhoods, stable Kneser dihedral actions and the nine-degree module have materially different objects or homological degrees. No equivalent or dominating result was identified; residual risk from unindexed equivariant work remains.

value.rationale: For the first nontrivial triple Kneser independence complex highlighted by the recent exact Betti theorem, the complete 29-dimensional sixth-homology representation is a mathematically natural invariant beyond homology ranks. Its conjugate pair of fourteen-dimensional irreducibles and unique invariant line reveal structural symmetry and determine traces for every permutation. The representation is not a routine substitution into the Betti formula and is computed using fifteen genuinely distinct geometric fixed-point complexes.
